$why: Who is named together in the folders, for the Findings tab's people network. Evidence only from the leaves: a letter to or from the person, a text of theirs in the folder, or his naming them where the words next to the name make it an attribution or an exchange — « th. de Hodge », « d'après Deligne », « lettre à Verdier », « cf. Serre », « (H. Weyl) » — and not an object that merely bears a name, like « groupe de Galois » or « espace de Hilbert ». Built on 26 September 2026 from the folders then transcribed; folder 162-1, a register of papers lent, is left out, and so are ambiguous names and the collective Bourbaki. Every record points to the file and line it rests on.
